bug_semantics: Spring for GraphQL decodes attacker-controlled Connection cursor strings (after/before) in JsonKeysetCursorStrategy.fromCursor via a Jackson ObjectMapper with activateDefaultTyping(NON_FINAL). The PolymorphicTypeValidator used allowIfBaseType(Map.class), so any classpath type assignable to java.util.Map named in the cursor JSON is instantiated. If a gadget Map runs logic during construction or deserialization, a paginated GraphQL query becomes CWE-502 RCE. Attack requires a Connection field plus gadget classes on the classpath (CVSS 8.1 AC:H).
flaw_origin: Pagination cursors originally decoded as Map JSON without polymorphic typing (104eccb4, 2023-03-17). The first write of the unsafe mechanism is 577014f4 (2023-05-09, rstoyanchev, gh-684): JacksonObjectMapperCustomizer enabled default typing so date/keyset types survived round-trip and chose allowIfBaseType(Map.class) as the Map allow rule. Later UUID/enum/number subtype adds and the Jackson 3 port (7d7749a2) / Jackson 2 reinstatement (6ce4e53e) copied that same base-type rule; they are not a new origin.
